verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's documented model is autonomous resolution with post-hoc QA (Coach reviews 100% of tickets after the fact) and escalation to humans only when the AI can't resolve a case, not a pre-send draft-for-approval workflow. No evidence describes a mode where every agent reply is queued for human sign-off before reaching a customer. Missing for 10: any mention of a draft/approve workflow, human-in-the-loop send gating, or a configurable 'supervised' launch mode.
